snippet.title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui – 15 Minutes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
With blood beneath my blade, I paint new rouge upon my face,
An old friend visits, in a dream taking place.

Still, I remember every one, by day and through the night.
Those bound by love grow old; the righteous road runs long;
Today's notes of grace or grudge define not the final song.
Who says the Underworld is far away? 
All the better—once more I'll walk along.

As the game is still in early development, all footage was captured in-game from a work-in-progress build running at a 21:9 aspect ratio. The final release may differ.

snippet.title: Ulduar Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Ulduar has always been one of my favorite raids in World of Warcraft - an ancient titan complex packed with colossal architecture, mysterious machinery, corrupted Keepers, and some of the most iconic encounters from Wrath of the Lich King.

Our goal was to reimagine this legendary raid as a large-scale cinematic experience - something I had wanted to do since the raid was released in 2009.

I’d like to thank Kruithne and Marlamin for creating *wow.export* - an essential tool that allowed us to access the necessary in-game models, as well as Phorge for his extensive modeling work.

The finished trailer features 95 shots, compared with 53 in the Black Temple trailer and 57 in the Naxxramas trailer. It was rendered on four RTX 4090s over the past 2 months, and the total production time was 1 year and 9 months.

*Disclaimer:*
This is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with the official Classic or Anniversary servers.
